context.text: Design a bacterial expression vector plasmid. Organism annotation: Cloning vector pSIT. Selectable markers: tetracycline resistance protein and truncated beta-lactamase gene with a 4bp deletion, repaired by mutagenesis with oligo GTTGCCATTGCTGCAGGCATCGTGGTG (nucleotides 4573-4595) restoring ampicillin resistance and PstI site by 4 bp insertion. Promoters: phage T7 gene 10 promoter, the strongest phage T7 promoter, recognized by phage T7 RNA polymerase and lac promoter region. Payloads: 33 amino acid polypeptide; NcoI site (105) allows cloning at translation initiation (ATG); BamHI (141) allows cloning at 12 and EspI (193) at 30 amino acids downstream from ATG and lacIq. Terminators: phage T7 transcription terminator. Replication origins: ColE1 based origin of DNA replication, that proceeds counterclockwise from T (nucleotide 3518); ROP that down regulates plasmid copy number has been deleted in pSIT, providing higher DNA yields, pMB1/pUC origin, and phage f1 replication origin, allows procuring single stranded DNA from pSIT upon infection with a helper phage M13KO7 or R408. Length/topology target: 6101 bp circular plasmid.
